observations: Starting a second catalog download while one is running pauses the first (frontend aborts the previous controller; banner 'Download paused. It resumes from where it stopped.'). The paused Llama download kept a 469,186,318-byte partial and a journal and showed 'Resume download' / 'Remove'. Resuming worked on the second attempt; the first attempt showed 'Download failed.' with no reason.

ModelsScreen.tsx download()/importFile() show the generic 'Download failed.' whenever the rejection is not an Error instance, which is the case for every native string error from the download command (MODEL_DOWNLOAD_ERROR, MODEL_BUSY, INSUFFICIENT_STORAGE …); the code and message are lost in the Models screen (the Agent screen uses errorText and keeps the message). Low-severity UI finding; not a gate item.

While a second artifact of an installed entry downloads, the card shows both 'Downloaded and verified' (for the installed artifact) and the new progress bar under the same heading (screenshot 38); ambiguous but not wrong.
'Free storage' on the Models screen did not refresh after downloads (6.1 GB throughout), as the implementer already recorded.
The GTK folder chooser's path completion popup covers the Open button; confirming by Return in the location entry works.
AT-SPI 'impl_GetExtents: assertion ATK_IS_COMPONENT failed' CRITICAL lines in the app's stderr are from the accessibility queries made by the driver, not from app actions.
A transient rendering artifact (horizontal line across the sidebar) appeared in one frame (screenshot 10) with WEBKIT_DISABLE_DMABUF_RENDERER=1 on the NVIDIA desktop; not reproduced in later frames.
